retorts and canisters thrown helter-skelter, old instruments crammed everywhere! And on top of it all? The rubbish of ancestral memory! Ha! That’s your world, 浮士德! At least that’s what they call it! How can you still wonder what makes you tremble with fear? What else but the pain of that fear that smothers the very urge to live! God created man in the bosom of nature’s fullness, not circled round by skeletons and animal bones and grime and mold! Out of here! Out! Out into the world! Out into nature! And this book, this strange, this marvelous book by Nostradamus is all the guide you will need! With it you will read the course of the stars like an open book. Nature will teach you how spirits converse with spirits. What a waste to brood in arid speculation over magic symbols! Spirits, I feel you hovering near. Answer me, if you hear!

@@U00086@@
(He opens the book and perceives the sign of the Macrocosm.)

@@U00087@@
Ah!
translation:
@@U00085@@
蒸馏瓶和罐子乱七八糟地乱扔，旧仪器塞满了到处都是！最重要的是？祖传记忆的垃圾！哈!这就是你的世界，浮士德！至少他们是这么称呼的！你怎么还能想知道是什么让你恐惧得发抖呢？除了那种扼杀求生欲望的恐惧带来的痛苦之外，还能有什么呢！上帝在大自然的怀抱中创造了人类，而不是被骷髅、动物骨头、污垢和霉菌包围！离开这里！出去！走出去，走向世界！走进大自然！这本书，诺查丹玛斯写的这本奇怪的、奇妙的书就是你所需要的全部指南！有了它，你将像一本打开的书一样阅读星星的轨迹。大自然会教你灵魂如何与灵魂对话。对魔法符号进行枯燥的猜测是多么浪费啊！灵魂，我感觉到你在附近徘徊。如果你听到的话请回答我！

@@U00086@@
（他打开书，感知到宏观宇宙的迹象。）

@@U00087@@
啊！
